claim: The Ranee is a 24-suite boutique hotel rebuilt from two traditional 19th-century shophouses in Kuching's Old Town near the Waterfront and Carpenter Street.
quote: Stylishly rebuilt from two traditional 19th century shophouses and ingeniously adapted to modern standards of plush comfort.

claim: The Ranee Boutique Suites is a top-ranked Kuching boutique with rooms from roughly US$87 per night.
quote: The Ranee Boutique Suites ... Starting from $87 for 1 room, 1 night including taxes & fees.

claim: The Marian Boutique Lodging House is a restored heritage property whose rooms are named after former matrons and headmistresses of the former all-girls school.
quote: Each room is named in honour of former matrons and headmistresses of this former all-girls school.

claim: The Marian was an 1885 mansion built by Ong Ewe Hai that became St Mary's boarding house and is now Kuching's first heritage boutique lodging house.
quote: Formerly an all-girls boarding school dormitory, the Marian has been restored into Kuching's first Heritage Boutique Lodging House.

claim: The Marian retains its original colonial structure with steep stairs and no lift, not recommended for those with mobility issues.
quote: because the property retains its original structure, there is no lift, and the stairs are fairly steep

claim: Batik Boutique Hotel has 15 guestrooms with balconies and ranks #5 among Sarawak hotels, praised for its central location.
quote: Batik Boutique Hotel scores marginally better than The Marian Boutique Lodging House and ranks #5 in Sarawak. ... 15 guestrooms appointed with a safe box, a balcony, and a mini-fridge-bar.

claim: Batik Boutique Hotel is centrally located but some guests note noise from nearby bars.
quote: minor downsides mentioned were noise from nearby bars, limited breakfast choices

claim: Telang Usan Hotel, opened 1989 and family-run, is the world's first Orang Ulu owned and managed hotel; the name means 'Sweet River' in Kenyah.
quote: proudly known as the world's first Orang Ulu owned and managed hotel ... still owned and run by the Wan Ullok family.

claim: Telang Usan Hotel has 66 rooms, displays Orang Ulu art and warrior costumes, and sits in a quiet central corner 10-15 minutes' walk from the Waterfront.
quote: The hotel displays all the Orang Ulu warriors costumes like Tapong Se and others.

claim: Basaga Holiday Residences is a 1948 post-war colonial bungalow set in tropical gardens around a pool, with 33 rooms about 7 minutes from the city centre.
quote: built during the reign of the second White Rajah of Sarawak and sold to a Scottish doctor in the mid-1950s, with typical post-war colonial architecture.

claim: The LimeTree Hotel is a 42-room/8-suite boutique in Padungan whose Level-5 LimeLight rooftop lounge overlooks the Sarawak River and Mount Santubong.
quote: The LimeLight Rooftop Lounge ... boasts a breathtaking view of the river and Mt Santubong

claim: Guest reviews of the LimeTree rooftop bar are mixed, ranging from chill and well-served to too-loud.
quote: roof terrace is a nice place to relax in the evening

claim: Singgahsana Lodge was created in 1988 from a dilapidated row of shophouses as Kuching's first backpackers, decorated with tribal artefacts and a rooftop bar, and won a Sarawak Hornbill Tourism Award.
quote: Artefacts collected from the 30 or more ethnic tribes of Sarawak adorn each room and common area.

claim: Singgahsana Lodge is centrally located about five minutes' walk from the Kuching riverfront and offers private rooms.
quote: you're just five minutes walk away from restaurants, cafes, shops and the picturesque riverfront.

claim: The Village House Santubong blends timber stilts, woven textiles, ironwood four-poster beds and art by Ramsay Ong in a lush garden setting.
quote: timber stilts, woven textiles, vintage art by local artist Ramsay Ong, and ironwood four-poster beds.

claim: The Village House is a Malay-style boutique at the foot of Mount Santubong serving Sarawakian fare at its Blue Ginger restaurant.
quote: Tranquil Malay-style Village House At The Foot of Kuching's Iconic Gunung Santubong

claim: Guests praise The Village House as well-maintained with a lovely pool lined by frangipani trees, a 3-minute walk from Santubong Beach.
quote: a lovely pool with frangipani trees either end.

claim: Cove 55 was originally built as a private home for an Iban family and is now an intimate Santubong retreat of 13 rooms, 2 suites and 13 villas with an infinity pool over the South China Sea.
quote: Built originally as a private home for an Iban family, the sprawling property is now reborn as an intimate retreat with 13 rooms, 2 suites and 13 villas.

claim: Cove 55 villas include private ocean-view pools and mangrove decks, with decor reviewers call fresh and modern, blending with the environment.
quote: Some villas have private ocean-view pools, while others have a private outdoor mangrove deck.

claim: Permai Rainforest Resort is an eco-resort 35 km from Kuching under Mount Santubong, designed to minimise environmental impact, with treehouse accommodation.
quote: an eco-resort ... designed to minimise its impact on the environment

claim: Permai offers about 10 treehouses built on stilts 20 feet up in the forest canopy plus forest cabins, with jungle trekking, high ropes, paddleboarding and a natural jungle pool.
quote: 10 treehouses, built on stilts 20 feet above the ground, placing you in the forest canopy.

claim: Damai Beach Resort sits on 90 acres along Teluk Bandung beach at the foot of Mount Santubong facing the South China Sea.
quote: situated along the sandy beach of Teluk Bandung & facing the South China Sea ... on 90 acres of sea frontage.

claim: Damai Beach Resort has rooms, chalets and suites near the Sarawak Cultural Village but reviews are mixed, noting dated facilities and upkeep issues.
quote: some reviewers noted maintenance issues like dated facilities, cleanliness concerns

claim: Bako National Park offers park-run forest lodges, chalets and a hostel, with fan/AC Forest Lodges from RM75-150 and hostel beds at RM15, reached by boat.
quote: Forest Lodge Type 6 (2 beds, fan, attached bathroom and toilet): RM 75 per night ... Air-conditioned Forest Lodge Type 4 ... RM 150

claim: Bako accommodation is basic, must be booked in advance via the official Sarawak e-booking website, and an overnight enables a guided night tour; guests bring their own towel.
quote: Accommodation at Bako National Park can only be booked via the official government website.

claim: Borneo Highlands Resort is a rainforest mountain-plateau retreat about 1.25 hours from Kuching, valued as an eco-friendly cooler-climate getaway.
quote: located amid natural beauty on the mountain plateau and lush tropical rain forest

claim: Borneo Highlands Resort has 40 rooms, suites and chalets with a golf course, spa and organic cafe, near Annah Rais hot springs and longhouse.
quote: The resort provides 40 rooms and suites and picturesque chalets ... features a golf course, spa tub, and sauna.

claim: Annah Rais is a traditional Bidayuh longhouse of 80+ families about 60 km from Kuching, developed into a homestay programme with overnight guestrooms and trips to waterfalls and hot springs.
quote: Annah Rais Bidayuh Longhouse has been developed into a Homestay Programme ... a chance to stay overnight

claim: The Sarawak Tourism Board lists Annah Rais Longhouse as an official Bidayuh cultural homestay near Kuching.
quote: Annah Rais Long House

claim: Annah Rais longhouse homestay activities include communal meals, blowpipe shooting, bamboo rafting and nearby waterfalls.
quote: trying on traditional costumes, a village tour, traditional food, bamboo rafting on the river, and blow pipe shooting.

claim: Nanga Sumpa Lodge, established 1987 with the Iban on the Delok River (1.5-hr longboat beyond Batang Ai lake), is a village stay with three en-suite Forest Rooms, generator power evenings and oil lamps after 10:30 pm.
quote: established in 1987 in partnership with the people of Nanga Sumpa longhouse ... three Forest Rooms ... include ensuite bathrooms.

claim: Aiman Batang Ai Resort & Retreat (former Hilton Batang Ai) is designed as a longhouse on Lake Batang Ai, reached by road plus boat, around 4 hours from Kuching.
quote: designed in the form of a longhouse, with all rooms enjoying long communal verandas with forest or stunning views out over the lake.

claim: Aiman Batang Ai has about 100 longhouse-design rooms and suites with communal verandas, accessed by boat, offering naturalist guides, canopy walks and fishing.
quote: The resort has 100 rooms and suites designed in the form of a longhouse

claim: Santubong Family Homestay is a village homestay owned by a certified tourist guide with Mount Santubong views, minutes from the Sarawak Cultural Village.
quote: Located in Kampung Santubong, our homestay offers village charm and modern amenities ... just 10 minutes from the Sarawak Cultural Village.

claim: Homestay Kampung Santubong is a Malay fishing-village homestay at the Sarawak river mouth with Mount Santubong and the South China Sea behind it.
quote: located within the serenity of Kampung Santubong, which is a small fishing village, located about 42 kilometers from Kuching City.

claim: Borneo Glamping is run by Borneo Outdoor and Eco Adventure for fireside tented stays in nature near Kuching; its website was being upgraded at research time.
quote: In the meantime, feel free to relax and wait by the fire with us.

claim: Kuching neighbourhoods break down as Old Town/Waterfront (most alive at night), Padungan/Chinatown (cafes and nightlife) and Damai Beach (relaxed resort area ~30 min north).
quote: Padungan is great for those on a budget and has a bit of everything ... Damai Beach offers sun and sand as well as easy access to the city

claim: The best time to visit Kuching is the drier months April to September; the wet northeast monsoon runs November to February with December and January wettest.
quote: The wet season, from November to February, is caused by the Northeast Monsoon and brings heavy rainfall, with December and January being the rainiest.

claim: Kuching is driest and busiest from June to August, the peak season for festivals and trekking.
quote: From June to August, Kuching is at its driest and busiest

claim: The Rainforest World Music Festival 2026 runs 26-28 June 2026 at the Sarawak Cultural Village in Santubong near Kuching.
quote: Rainforest World Music Festival 2026 | June 26-28, Sarawak

claim: Hotels in Kuching city and resorts around the Santubong peninsula fill months in advance during the Rainforest World Music Festival, so book 3-6 months ahead.
quote: Hotels in Kuching city and resorts around the Santubong peninsula fill up months in advance.

claim: The Kuching Waterfront Bazaar area is the central, hotel-lined riverfront precinct in the Old Town.
quote: hotels near Kuching Waterfront Bazaar

claim: Kuching is one of the wettest places in Malaysia with about 247 days of rainfall a year and January the wettest month at over 660 mm.
quote: Kuching is considered one of the wettest places in Malaysia and receives at least 247 days of rainfall each year.
